query: For every supplied mention and its context, use its complete report and frozen definitions to return the ATT&CK technique ID(s) it denotes. Boundaries and technical-mention selection are given. This is conditional linking of published positive annotations, not end-to-end detection, negative detection, or a complete report inventory. Preserve subtechnique specificity: use Txxxx.xxx, without collapsing to the parent. Return a duplicate-free list.

task_definition.request: For every supplied mention and its context, use its complete report and frozen definitions to return the ATT&CK technique ID(s) it denotes. Boundaries and technical-mention selection are given. This is conditional linking of published positive annotations, not end-to-end detection, negative detection, or a complete report inventory. Preserve subtechnique specificity: use Txxxx.xxx, without collapsing to the parent. Return a duplicate-free list.

output_value.value: Ranked, duplicate-free list of public catalog label_id strings; singleton for HSCodeComp/UDRP. Empty OK is allowed for set-valued tasks. ABSTAIN uses null value and nonempty reason.
output_value.evidence_refs: Optional list of public relative file paths. Existence is checked; evidence sufficiency is not inferred.
output_value.ranking: Order is prediction rank, not source gold order. No confidence values are required.

task_definition.evidence: records.json defines the full batch; paths are relative to public/. Shared resources are under lake/.
task_definition.execution_failure: ABSTAIN with null value and a reason. Insufficient evidence is not a negative label.
